response.justification: The candidate substantially exceeds the experience requirement with ~18 years of fullstack development, current hands-on AI agent and MCP tooling work, strong TypeScript/Node.js product experience, and a demonstrated testing/craftsmanship culture (TDD, CI/CD, workshops). Gaps are mostly stack-alignment details: no explicit Nest.js, Kotlin, or Vitest/Playwright experience, and much of the frontend history is Ember.js rather than React, but these are learnable given the depth shown elsewhere.
strengths: Extensive fullstack experience with TypeScript, Node.js, MongoDB, AWS, and Docker/Kubernetes
Current AI agent infrastructure experience, including MCP code generators and agentic workflow tooling
Strong engineering culture: TDD, pairing, trunk-based development, plus teaching/workshop leadership
concerns: No explicit Nest.js experience, and React exposure appears limited relative to Ember.js
Kotlin and Python are not listed; secondary JVM stack coverage relies on older Java experience
Testing tooling listed (Selenium, D-language frameworks) doesn't include Jest, Vitest, or Playwright

key_factors.factor: Partial mismatch on primary stack (Nest.js, React depth, Vitest)
